entries.label: dan_start_01_sitappa_01
entries.text:
Heads up, gang! Some jumped-up kid has
wandered in thinking [VAR 0x1100(00FF,0100)]she can raid our base!\c
Clearly [VAR 0x1100(00FF,0100)]she doesn’t know who [VAR 0x1100(00FF,0100)]she’s messing with.
Let’s teach h[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0202)]imer a lesson [VAR 0x1100(00FF,0100)]she won’t forget![VAR 0x0114(002F)]

entries.label: dan_start_01_sitappa_02
entries.text: To our unwanted guest—if you can defeat [VAR 0x0201(0002)] of\nour Pokémon in the next [VAR 0x0201(0001)] minutes, our boss\r\nmight just honor you with an appearance![VAR 0x0114(002F)]

entries.label: dan_start_02_sitappa_01
entries.text:
Some kid lucked out beating one of our sister
squads, and now [VAR 0x1100(00FF,0100)]she thinks [VAR 0x1100(00FF,0100)]she can take us on!\c
Time to give h[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0202)]imer the boot, gang! Let’s show this
gate-crasher what Team Star can do![VAR 0x0114(002F)]

entries.label: dan_start_02_sitappa_02
entries.text:
And if you’re listening, gate-crasher, know this!\c
Unless you can beat [VAR 0x0201(0002)] of our Pokémon in
[VAR 0x0201(0001)] minutes, our boss won’t lift a finger to deal
with the likes of you![VAR 0x0114(002F)]

entries.label: dan_start_03_sitappa_01
entries.text:
Seems the folks behind Operation Star-FOOL
are finally making a move against our base!\c
You know what that means, gang! Time for us to
shine bright and avenge our teammates![VAR 0x0114(002F)]

entries.label: dan_start_03_sitappa_02
entries.text:
And hey, little intruder, just so you know...\c
If you’ve got the skills to defeat [VAR 0x0201(0002)] of our
Pokémon in [VAR 0x0201(0001)] minutes, our boss might deem
you worthy to meet in person! Heh, break a leg![VAR 0x0114(002F)]

entries.label: dan_start_04_sitappa_01
entries.text: Code red! Code red! Operation Starfall alert!\c\nEveryone, get into position and defend the boss\nwith all you got![VAR 0x0114(002F)]

entries.label: dan_start_04_sitappa_02
entries.text:
And rest assured, intruder—we’ll deal with you
without the boss’s help...\c
Unless you manage to beat [VAR 0x0201(0002)] of our Pokémon
in [VAR 0x0201(0001)] minutes, that is. Good luck with that![VAR 0x0114(002F)]

entries.label: dan_start_05_sitappa_01
entries.text:
Even the smallest stars can light up the sky when
they shine together as constellations!\c
We’re the last bastion of Team Star! Losing isn’t
an option![VAR 0x0114(002F)]

entries.label: dan_start_05_sitappa_02
entries.text: Hey, kid—you listening? If you beat [VAR 0x0201(0002)] of our\nPokémon in [VAR 0x0201(0001)] minutes, we’ll call the boss out\r\nto deal with ya! How’s that for hospitality?[VAR 0x0114(002F)]

entries.label: dan_start_06_sitappa_01
entries.text: Watch out, gang—[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0100)]she’s back! That awful kid who\npummeled our crew to stardust![VAR 0x0114(002F)]

entries.label: dan_start_06_sitappa_02
entries.text: The boss isn’t around anymore, but we’ll still\ndefend the base with everything we got![VAR 0x0114(002F)]

entries.label: dan_lose_06_sitappa_01
entries.text: Sorry, Boss... We couldn’t protect the base...\c\nHaven’t you had enough, kid? Just...go away\nalready.[VAR 0x0114(002F)]

entries.label: dan_lose_06_sitappa_02
entries.text: Doesn’t matter if you keep raiding us like this—\nwe don’t have any more LP to give!\c\nGo find some other base to pound into the dirt![VAR 0x0114(002F)]

entries.label: dan_lose_06_sitappa_01b
entries.text: Sorry, Boss... We couldn’t protect the base...\c\nHaven’t you had enough, kid? Just...go away\nalready.[VAR 0x0114(002F)]

entries.label: dan_lose_06_sitappa_02b
entries.text: Doesn’t matter if you keep raiding us like this—\nwe don’t have any more LP to give!\c\nGo find some other base to pound into the dirt![VAR 0x0114(002F)]

entries.label: dan_win_06_sitappa_01
entries.text: Even if we beat you in battle, it’s not like that’ll\nbring our boss back...\c\nJust leave us alone, would ya?[VAR 0x0114(002F)]

entries.label: dan_win_06_sitappa_01b
entries.text: Even if we beat you in battle, it’s not like that’ll\nbring our boss back...\c\nJust leave us alone, would ya?[VAR 0x0114(002F)]

entries.label: dan_active_07_honooboss_02
entries.text: Just browsin’, huh? What a drag. Come back an’\nsee me when you’re more fired up.[VAR 0x0114(001F)]

entries.label: dan_start_07_honooboss_01
entries.text: Defeat [VAR 0x0202(0002)] Pokémon in [VAR 0x0201(0001)] minute[VAR 0x1101(0001,0100)]s!\c\nThat’s a proper challenge worth getting fired up\nfor, yeah?[VAR 0x0114(001F)]

entries.label: dan_start_07_honooboss_02
entries.text: Hey, Schedar Squad! Y’all ready?! It’s GO TIME![VAR 0x0114(001F)]

entries.label: dan_berforebtl_07_honooboss_01
entries.text: All riiight, BRING IT! I’ll blow everythin’ sky high![VAR 0x0114(001F)]

entries.label: dan_afterbtl_07_honooboss_01
entries.text: Gotta give praise where it’s due, [VAR 0x1100(00FF,0403)]mangirl.\nThat was lit.\c\nHasta la vistar... ☆[VAR 0x0114(001F)]

entries.label: dan_win_07_honooboss_01
entries.text:
Seems you beat the [VAR 0x0202(0001)] target Pokémon in...
[VAR 0x0202(0003)] minute[VAR 0x1101(0003,0100)]s, [VAR 0x0201(0004)] second[VAR 0x1101(0004,0100)]s.\c
You get [VAR 0x0205(0002,002C)] LP from me, then. And with
that, hasta la vistar! ☆[VAR 0x0114(001F)]

entries.label: dan_win_07_honooboss_04
entries.text:
Seems you beat the [VAR 0x0202(0001)] target Pokémon in...
[VAR 0x0202(0003)] minute[VAR 0x1101(0003,0100)]s, [VAR 0x0201(0004)] second[VAR 0x1101(0004,0100)]s.\c
But you know you’ve been goin’ hard on my crew
and lettin’ the others off the hook, right?
For that, I’m cuttin’ your earnings to [VAR 0x0205(0002,002C)] LP.[VAR 0x0114(001F)]

entries.label: dan_after_07_honooboss_01
entries.text: I’m callin’ it quits for today. If you’re burnin’ to\nchallenge me again, come back tomorrow.[VAR 0x0114(001F)]

entries.label: dan_lose_07_honooboss_01
entries.text: Man, I was hopin’ you’d show us some red-hot\nbattles... You barely even sizzled out there.[VAR 0x0114(001F)]

entries.label: dan_active_07_akuboss_02
entries.text: Whoa, that’s actually kind of a bummer.\nCome back whenever you wanna tango![VAR 0x0114(0021)]

entries.label: dan_start_07_akuboss_01
entries.text: You gotta defeat [VAR 0x0202(0002)] Pokémon in [VAR 0x0201(0001)] minute[VAR 0x1101(0001,0100)]s.\nShould be a breeze with your skills![VAR 0x0114(0021)]

entries.label: dan_start_07_akuboss_02
entries.text: All right, Segin Squad, time to take the stage!\nLet the music play![VAR 0x0114(0021)]

entries.label: dan_berforebtl_07_akuboss_01
entries.text: Thanks for answerin’ the call of the stage! I’ll\nhave you dancin’ to my tune in no time![VAR 0x0114(0021)]

entries.label: dan_afterbtl_07_akuboss_01
entries.text: You turned my melody into a threnody... Can’t\nsay I’m too stoked about it, but nice work!\c\nHasta la vistar! ☆[VAR 0x0114(0021)]

entries.label: dan_win_07_akuboss_01
entries.text:
This time, you defeated [VAR 0x0202(0001)] Pokémon in...
[VAR 0x0202(0003)] minute[VAR 0x1101(0003,0100)]s and [VAR 0x0201(0004)] second[VAR 0x1101(0004,0100)]s!\c
Here’s [VAR 0x0205(0002,002C)] LP from me for your efforts.
Hasta la vistar! ☆[VAR 0x0114(0021)]

entries.label: dan_win_07_akuboss_04
entries.text:
This time, you defeated [VAR 0x0202(0001)] Pokémon in...
[VAR 0x0202(0003)] minute[VAR 0x1101(0003,0100)]s and [VAR 0x0201(0004)] second[VAR 0x1101(0004,0100)]s!\c
But, yo, how ’bout you take on the other crews
sometime? You’re only gettin’ [VAR 0x0205(0002,002C)] LP from
me till you do![VAR 0x0114(0021)]

entries.label: dan_after_07_akuboss_01
entries.text: You think I got it in me for an encore right now?\nI’m flattered, but that’s just not happenin’.\r\nSave that energy for tomorrow, pal![VAR 0x0114(0021)]

entries.label: dan_lose_07_akuboss_01
entries.text:
Guess you were off your game, huh? Come
challenge us again when you’re back in form!\c
Like a li’l angry Pokémon usin’ Payback, you
know? That’s the mood I want from you![VAR 0x0114(0021)]

entries.label: dan_start_07_dokuboss_01
entries.text: Thy goal is [VAR 0x0202(0002)] Pokémon, to be defeated in the\nspan of [VAR 0x0201(0001)] fleeting minute[VAR 0x1101(0001,0100)]s.[VAR 0x0114(0023)]

entries.label: dan_start_07_dokuboss_02
entries.text: Hark, Navi Squad, my knights o’th’ battle!\nThe time for feast and sport is upon us![VAR 0x0114(0023)]

entries.label: dan_berforebtl_07_dokuboss_01
entries.text: Though I am grateful for thy coming here, be\nwarned—I shall spare thee no mercy! En garde![VAR 0x0114(0023)]

entries.label: dan_afterbtl_07_dokuboss_01
entries.text: You came here to train, yet I am the one who\nmust learn from YOU. Magnificent!\c\nHasta la vistar, my good [VAR 0x1100(00FF,0406)]fellowlady! ☆[VAR 0x0114(0023)]

entries.label: dan_win_07_dokuboss_01
entries.text:
The defeat of [VAR 0x0202(0001)] Pokémon by thy hand took...
[VAR 0x0202(0003)] minute[VAR 0x1101(0003,0100)]s and [VAR 0x0201(0004)] second[VAR 0x1101(0004,0100)]s precisely!\c
Take [VAR 0x0205(0002,002C)] LP as a most deserved reward.
Hasta la vistar, my good [VAR 0x1100(00FF,0406)]fellowlady! ☆[VAR 0x0114(0023)]

entries.label: dan_win_07_dokuboss_04
entries.text:
The defeat of [VAR 0x0202(0001)] Pokémon by thy hand took...
[VAR 0x0202(0003)] minute[VAR 0x1101(0003,0100)]s and [VAR 0x0201(0004)] second[VAR 0x1101(0004,0100)]s precisely!\c
But know this—a mere [VAR 0x0205(0002,002C)] LP shall be thy
reward till thou darest to confront a crew aside
from mine own![VAR 0x0114(0023)]

entries.label: dan_after_07_dokuboss_01
entries.text: I shall take no more challenges today. Return\non the morrow to battle again, should you wish.[VAR 0x0114(0023)]

entries.label: dan_lose_07_dokuboss_02
entries.text: My subordinates have grown strong. I would\nadvise thee to likewise look to thy training.[VAR 0x0114(0023)]

entries.label: dan_active_07_fairyboss_02
entries.text: Awww! Come on, it’s boring here without you\nto keep me entertained![VAR 0x0114(0020)]

entries.label: dan_start_07_fairyboss_01
entries.text: Let’s see if you can beat at least [VAR 0x0202(0002)] Pokémon\nin [VAR 0x0201(0001)] minute[VAR 0x1101(0001,0100)]s, shall we?[VAR 0x0114(0020)]

entries.label: dan_start_07_fairyboss_02
entries.text: Ruchbah Squad—hop to it! Let’s get this show on\nthe road![VAR 0x0114(0020)]

entries.label: dan_berforebtl_07_fairyboss_01
entries.text: Heh, you got guts. But so what? You’ll still be\nkicking yourself after I’m through with you![VAR 0x0114(0020)]

entries.label: dan_afterbtl_07_fairyboss_01
entries.text: Ugh, this sucks! I’ll beat you next time for sure...\nso enjoy your win while you still can!\c\nHasta la vistar! ☆[VAR 0x0114(0020)]

entries.label: dan_win_07_fairyboss_01
entries.text:
Looks like you defeated [VAR 0x0202(0001)] Pokémon in...
Huh. Exactly [VAR 0x0202(0003)] minute[VAR 0x1101(0003,0100)]s, [VAR 0x0201(0004)] second[VAR 0x1101(0004,0100)]s.\c
I guess you’ve earned yourself [VAR 0x0205(0002,002C)] LP.
Hasta la vistar and all that... ☆[VAR 0x0114(0020)]

entries.label: dan_win_07_fairyboss_04
entries.text:
Looks like you defeated [VAR 0x0202(0001)] Pokémon in...
Huh. Exactly [VAR 0x0202(0003)] minute[VAR 0x1101(0003,0100)]s, [VAR 0x0201(0004)] second[VAR 0x1101(0004,0100)]s.\c
But don’t keep beating the snot out of my crew
and none of the others, you jerk! For being
literally the WORST, you only get [VAR 0x0205(0002,002C)] LP.[VAR 0x0114(0020)]

entries.label: dan_after_07_fairyboss_01
entries.text: I’m gonna spend the rest of today fixing the\nStarmobile you totaled. Remember that?\c\nGo bother someone else till tomorrow![VAR 0x0114(0020)]

entries.label: dan_lose_07_fairyboss_02
entries.text: I’m totally shook that you couldn’t even make it\npast my lackeys. How unreal is that?\c\nHonestly...step up your game next time.[VAR 0x0114(0020)]

entries.label: dan_active_07_kakutouboss_02
entries.text: OK, gotcha! Come back whenever you want![VAR 0x0114(0022)]

entries.label: dan_start_07_kakutouboss_01
entries.text: Your goal is to defeat [VAR 0x0202(0002)] Pokémon in\n[VAR 0x0201(0001)] minute[VAR 0x1101(0001,0100)]s! I’m sure you can do it![VAR 0x0114(0022)]

entries.label: dan_start_07_kakutouboss_02
entries.text: And Caph Squad—listen up! Get your heads in\nthe game, because the battle starts...now![VAR 0x0114(0022)]

entries.label: dan_berforebtl_07_kakutouboss_01
entries.text: I’m always ready to battle! Let’s see if you can\nhandle my full power![VAR 0x0114(0022)]

entries.label: dan_afterbtl_07_kakutouboss_01
entries.text: That was a great battle! Thanks so much for\nsparring with me today!\c\nHasta la vistar! ☆[VAR 0x0114(0022)]

entries.label: dan_win_07_kakutouboss_01
entries.text:
It seems you defeated [VAR 0x0202(0001)] Pokémon in...
[VAR 0x0202(0003)] minutes and [VAR 0x0201(0004)] seconds.\c
That’s earned you a total of [VAR 0x0205(0002,002C)] LP!
Thanks again, and hasta la vistar! ☆[VAR 0x0114(0022)]

entries.label: dan_win_07_kakutouboss_04
entries.text:
It seems you defeated [VAR 0x0202(0001)] Pokémon in...
[VAR 0x0202(0003)] minutes and [VAR 0x0201(0004)] seconds.\c
I’d like you to test your skills against the other
crews too, though. So you’ll only be getting
[VAR 0x0205(0002,002C)] LP from me this time. Sorry![VAR 0x0114(0022)]

entries.label: dan_lose_07_kakutouboss_02
entries.text: The Caph Squad is pretty formidable, right?\nThey train every day, and it really shows.[VAR 0x0114(0022)]

entries.label: dan_insert_sitappa_06a
entries.text: [VAR 0x1100(00FF,0201)]HShe’s way above our level! We’ve gotta get\nthe boss![VAR 0x0114(002F)]

entries.label: dan_insert_sitappa_06b
entries.text: Our defenses are breached... It’s all up to the\nboss now![VAR 0x0114(002F)]

entries.label: dan_insert_sitappa_13b
entries.text: I...I don’t think we can hold h[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0202)]imer off much longer,\nBoss...[VAR 0x0114(002F)]

entries.label: dan_system_02
entries.text: Do you want to quit the Star Barrage?

entries.label: dan_heal_neruke_02
entries.text: There, all better. Eyes on the prize now—we need\nto see this operation through.[VAR 0x0114(001E)]

entries.label: dan_heal_neruke_03
entries.text: How goes the operation? Bring your Pokémon\nhere, and I’ll heal them up for you.[VAR 0x0114(001E)]

entries.label: dan_heal_sitappa_02
entries.text: There, good as new!\c\nOnce you’re all wrapped up here, let’s head on\nout and get ready to raid the next base.[VAR 0x0114(001E)]

entries.label: dan_heal_sitappa_03
entries.text: Bring your Pokémon here, and I’ll heal them up\nfor you.[VAR 0x0114(001E)]

entries.label: dan_heal_sitappa_05
entries.text:
There, all done! Good luck with the rest of your
STC battles!\c
And remember—your trusty coach Clive is right
here watching over your progress![VAR 0x0114(001E)]

entries.label: dan_heal_sitappa_06
entries.text: The STC was my idea, so I’m here to help out.[VAR 0x0114(001E)]

entries.label: dan_system_03
entries.text: You’re in the middle of a Star Barrage! You can’t\nleave the base now!

entries.label: dan_vending_machine_1
entries.text: You used Team Star’s vending machine to\nrefresh your party!

entries.label: dan_lose_hint_honoo
entries.text:
Yeaaah! Go us! We sure showed that gate-crasher
what’s what!\c
Good thing [VAR 0x1100(00FF,0100)]she didn’t drench our Fire-type
Pokémon with a team of Water types! Haha![VAR 0x0114(002F)]

entries.label: dan_lose_hint_aku
entries.text:
Wooo! That no-good intruder will think twice
before [VAR 0x1100(00FF,0100)]she messes with us again!\c
Lucky [VAR 0x1100(00FF,0100)]she didn’t whale on our Pokémon with the
Fighting- and Bug-type moves they’re so weak to![VAR 0x0114(002F)]

entries.label: dan_lose_hint_doku
entries.text: Hooraaay! That intruder is good as gone!\c\nWe wouldn’t have got off so easy if [VAR 0x1100(00FF,0100)]she’d had a\nteam of Ground or Psychic types... Phew![VAR 0x0114(002F)]

entries.label: dan_lose_hint_kakutou
entries.text:
Woo-hoo! We sent that would-be raider scurrying
off with h[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0202)]iser tail between h[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0202)]iser legs!\c
I almost feel like telling h[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0202)]imer that our Pokémon
are super weak to Flying types... But I won’t![VAR 0x0114(002F)]

entries.label: dan_lose_hint_fairy
entries.text:
Waheeey! That intruder won’t be bothering us
again anytime soon!\c
Good thing [VAR 0x1100(00FF,0100)]she didn’t take on our Fairy-type
cuties with a team of Poison or Steel types![VAR 0x0114(002F)]

entries.label: dan_tutorial_neruke_02
entries.text: They call it a Star Barrage![VAR 0x0114(001E)]

entries.label: dan_tutorial_neruke_03
entries.text: To get through it, you’ll need to use the [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]R Button[VAR 0xFF00(0000)]\nto send out multiple Pokémon and have them\r\nbattle at the same time.[VAR 0x0114(001E)]

entries.label: dan_tutorial_neruke_04
entries.text: If your Pokémon get[VAR 0x1101(00FD,0001)]s low on health, come back\nhere and I’ll heal [VAR 0x1101(00FD,0402)]itthem up for you.[VAR 0x0114(001E)]

entries.label: dan_tutorial_neruke_05
entries.text: The grunts you’ll be facing will heal up their\nPokémon, too, so stay sharp out there.[VAR 0x0114(001E)]

entries.label: dan_lose_end_01
entries.text: You have no more Pokémon that can fight!

entries.label: dan_lose_end_02
entries.text: You were overwhelmed by your defeat!

entries.label: dan_vending_machine_2
entries.text: Oh? It seems you can’t use the vending machine\nright now!

entries.label: dan_talk_06_sitappa01_a
entries.text:
We’ll protect this base with all we got while the
boss is away!\c
If you wanna challenge us to a Star Barrage,
go on and ring the bell at the gates if you dare![VAR 0x0114(002F)]

entries.label: dan_talk_06_sitappa01_b
entries.text:
We’ll protect this base with all we got, even if
the boss ain’t here!\c
You wanna challenge us to a Star Barrage?
Go ahead and ring the bell at the gates![VAR 0x0114(002F)]
